'''Velst Nay'sro''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who served in the [[Bothan Combat Response Element]] and was tasked with tracking [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s forces in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
